rows.note: Use 質素 as the all-purpose noun for a thing’s level of excellence or good make.

example.english: The quality of this phone is really good.
example.traditional: 呢部手機嘅質素真係唔錯。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 ge3 zat1 sou3 zan1 hai6 m4 co3

rows.note: Use 性質 for the nature or general characteristics of something, especially when contrasting them with its quantity.

example.english: The quality and quantity of this product are equally important.
example.traditional: 呢種產品嘅性質同數量一樣重要。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 caan2 ban2 ge3 sing3 zat1 tung4 sou3 loeng6 jat1 joeng6 zung6 jiu3

rows.note: Use 特質 for one identifiable trait of a person or thing rather than its overall excellence.

example.english: Her biggest quality is that she is very thoughtful.
example.traditional: 佢最大嘅特質係好細心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 dak6 zat1 hai6 hou2 sai3 sam1

rows.note: Use 質地 specifically for the physical texture or material quality of something.

example.english: The quality of this fabric feels very soft.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 zat1 dei6 hou2 jau4 jyun5
